response.justification: Bogdan has over 15 years of technical experience with excellent alignment in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines. However, this is a Level II Engineering Manager role requiring at least 2 years of formal people management and a focus on team development. Bogdan's background is entirely on the Individual Contributor (IC) track, and his resume lacks any explicit evidence of people management, conducting 1-on-1s, or performance management.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (over 15 years), easily exceeding the 8-year minimum requirement.
Deep technical expertise in the required domain, including developer tools, CI/CD infrastructure, and test automation.
Proven technical leadership as a Staff Engineer, workshop organizer, and founder of an open-source platform.
concerns: Lacks the required 2 years of formal people management or team leadership experience.
Career trajectory is firmly on the Individual Contributor (IC) path, which does not align with a full-time people-leadership role.
No evidence of the preferred experience in leading large-scale organizational change.
